command_line:
set -eu
cat > fit_logit.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
infile <- args[[1]]
outfile <- args[[2]]
raw <- read.delim(infile, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
required <- c("Efficacy", "Age")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required, names(raw))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}
efficacy <- trimws(as.character(raw[["Efficacy"]]))
age <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw[["Age"]]))
known_status <- efficacy %in% c("CR", "PR", "SD", "PD")
keep <- !is.na(age) & known_status
model_df <- data.frame(
  response = as.integer(efficacy[keep] %in% c("CR", "PR")),
  Age = age[keep]
)
if (nrow(model_df) == 0) {
  stop("No usable rows after filtering")
}
if (length(unique(model_df$response)) != 2) {
  stop("Response is not binary after filtering")
}
fit <- glm(response ~ Age, data = model_df, family = binomial())
result <- data.frame(
  term = "Age",
  estimate = unname(coef(fit)[["Age"]]),
  n = nrow(model_df),
  responders = sum(model_df$response == 1),
  nonresponders = sum(model_df$response == 0),
  event = "CR_or_PR",
  reference = "SD_or_PD",
  model = "glm_response_logit_intercept_plus_age"
)
write.table(result, file = outfile, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript fit_logit.R "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78533633/inputs/dataset_cbade0b5-0673-47c9-8842-8e2bedec21eb.dat" result.tsv
